title: SaaS metrics definitions
description: For a change to recurring revenue, plans or dashboards: one written definition per metric, computed from the billing system and reconciled with recognised revenue.

sources.title: IFRS Foundation, IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers
Stripe, Billing analytics (MRR, churn and subscriber reports)

rules.instruction: Write the definition of MRR, ARR, logo churn, revenue churn and net revenue retention in the metrics glossary, with the formula, what is included and excluded, and the owner.
rules.verification: Open the metrics glossary and check that each metric the change touches has a formula, inclusions, exclusions and an owner.

rules.instruction: Compute recurring revenue metrics from the billing system of record named in the glossary, not from CRM opportunity amounts.
rules.verification: Read the dashboard query or export and check that its source is the billing table or report named in the glossary.

rules.instruction: Each month, reconcile MRR with the recurring revenue recognised in the ledger and explain the difference.
rules.verification: Open the reconciliation for the last closed month and check that the difference is computed and explained.
